rules: These are planned regressions, not executed results.
All 94 original requirements remain mandatory and unchanged.
Supplemental checks add coverage and never weaken original test levels.
No PASS without actual assertions and matching source/schema/artifact evidence.
A parser or mock success cannot replace an original native or iOS requirement.

cases.title: Verification aggregator
cases.scenario: Inject an actually false assertion, contradictory boolean/status, duplicate ID, unknown ID, missing ID and malformed evidence.
cases.expected_observation: Every invalid result is rejected; closure exits nonzero; no success is counted from an unvalidated status string.

cases.title: Required evidence levels
cases.scenario: Provide a parser-only success for a native+iOS requirement and a runtime artifact from another SHA.
cases.expected_observation: Neither can satisfy the requirement; report actual levels as partial/NOT_RUN, not PASS.

cases.title: Portable contract intake
cases.scenario: Run from a fresh clone and an unrelated temporary working directory using repository/default or explicit contract location.
cases.expected_observation: No Downloads/home-directory dependency; immutable original contract digest and 94 IDs verified.

cases.title: Compile cannot bypass analysis
cases.scenario: Compile parser-valid programs with immutable reassignment, wrong type, duplicate/unknown label and missing argument through check, CLI and embedded APIs.
cases.expected_observation: Matching semantic errors prevent output/signing and preserve any pre-existing destination.

cases.title: Literal legacy-looking text
cases.scenario: Use email text containing @, plain JS containing const, plain #include text, and legacy-looking comments; contrast actual old declarations.
cases.expected_observation: Legal text is unchanged and compiles; actual old syntax receives E_LEGACY_SYNTAX through every public path.

cases.title: Current declaration propagation
cases.scenario: Modify an inherited optional parameter in a disposable worktree, export current definitions and regenerate.
cases.expected_observation: New schema/compiler/docs/completion see the actual change without editing baseline-catalog or generated output.

cases.title: Facet conflict is detected
cases.scenario: Change an upstream field relied on by a semantic facet; inject an unknown codec and duplicate label.
cases.expected_observation: Specific assumption/codec/label error fails generation; the change is not silently accepted.

cases.title: Schema fingerprint and typed facts
cases.scenario: Regenerate twice unchanged, then alter a semantic default/constant/codec version in a disposable fixture.
cases.expected_observation: Unchanged semantic output is deterministic; changed semantics change identity; typed false/zero/empty defaults retain presence.

cases.title: Static action variants
cases.scenario: Emit convertToJPEG, base64Encode/base64Decode and DNDOn/DNDOff using actual canonical definitions and new frontend fixtures.
cases.expected_observation: All fixed discriminators and mode values match independent canonical/native expectations.

cases.title: Custom callbacks and App Intents
cases.scenario: Exercise makeParams, appendParamsFunc and a complete App Intent descriptor using current canonical encoders.
cases.expected_observation: No behavior-bearing callback/static/descriptor data is lost by generic map serialization.

cases.title: Number-as-text and reference forms
cases.scenario: Pass semantic numeric width, a literal, mutable reference, action output, and contextual tokenized string to representative codecs.
cases.expected_observation: Correct wire forms are selected per parameter; no blanket raw-float or generic-attachment encoding.

cases.title: Named argument effect order
cases.scenario: Supply named arguments out of declaration order with independently observed effects.
cases.expected_observation: Arguments evaluate once in written order before binding/encoding; duplicates and unknown labels fail.

cases.title: Variadic list API
cases.scenario: Adapt one inherited variadic action to a named list; test zero, one, several and nested elements.
cases.expected_observation: Approved repeated-operand encoding is preserved without arbitrary positional tails or unapproved flattening.

cases.title: Binding capture and native types
cases.scenario: Capture a mutable variable and clipboard, change them, then consume saved values; include Number, Bool, list/map values.
cases.expected_observation: Saved values reflect the read time with correct types, not late reads or generic Text conversions.

cases.title: Compound assignment
cases.expected_observation: Actual returned Number is 11 and every RHS is evaluated once.

cases.title: Exhaustive node handling
cases.scenario: Send every approved expression/declaration/statement kind through checked lowering and inject an unknown node in a test.
cases.expected_observation: Required nodes work; deliberately unknown nodes fail explicitly; no silent nil success.

cases.title: Comparisons and arithmetic
cases.scenario: Evaluate 2>3, 2==2, 2!=2, 5/2, 10%3 and mixed unary/parenthesized expressions.
cases.expected_observation: Correct Bool/Number results and wire forms; no comparison or unknown operator defaults to addition.

cases.title: Observable short circuit
cases.scenario: Use safe marker effects in RHS helpers under false AND, true OR and mixed nested boolean trees.
cases.expected_observation: Unneeded RHS effects do not run; needed effects run once in order.

cases.title: Literal and Unicode f-strings
cases.scenario: Interpolate literal 42/false, action outputs and adjacent tokens after Hebrew, emoji and combining marks.
cases.expected_observation: Expected content/type formatting and exact attachment ranges; no unbound replacement characters.

cases.title: Container and optional shape
cases.scenario: Build nested lists/maps with false, zero, empty text/list/map and explicit optional/JSON-null contexts.
cases.expected_observation: Order/cardinality/shape and presence are preserved; plist null is not fabricated.

cases.title: Safe zero-based indexing
cases.scenario: Test first/last/empty/dynamic/negative/fractional/out-of-range index and a nonnumeric index.
cases.expected_observation: Approved zero-based/none/type-error behavior; unsafe native lookup is not executed.

cases.title: Loop item and index bindings
cases.scenario: Run nested for/repeat with named and tuple indices; shadow an outer name.
cases.expected_observation: Actual iteration values/order and zero-based indices are correct; scopes do not collide.

cases.title: Value block and loop yields
cases.scenario: Exercise yielded if/menu values and a yielded loop with zero/multiple iterations; omit a required yield deliberately.
cases.expected_observation: Correct block values and one element per iteration; missing or illegal yield is diagnosed.

cases.title: Function return and recursion
cases.scenario: Call add(2,b:3) then multiply its result by 2; run a small terminating recursion; reject illegal capture.
cases.expected_observation: Result is 10, caller continues, recursion returns correctly and no implicit main runtime capture occurs.

cases.title: Function default and transport
cases.scenario: Compare omitted arguments to explicit false/0/empty text/list/map using type-correct functions and structured results.
cases.expected_observation: Defaults apply only on absence; structured and optional transport does not collapse values.

cases.title: Caller input and Void
cases.scenario: Pass user input through a function chain; use a dictionary resembling a partial dispatch marker; test bare return/fallthrough.
cases.expected_observation: system.input remains user input; incomplete envelopes do not dispatch; Void does not leak incidental output.

cases.title: Real module resolution
cases.scenario: Use multiple actual module files and aliases, a cycle, forbidden library runtime init and unresolved remote dependency.
cases.expected_observation: Correct namespace resolution and diagnostics; no ignored import or automatic network install.

cases.title: Generated existing stdfunc
cases.scenario: Generate and import stdfunc from preserved original runJS/chooseFromVCard source; test dependencies and calls.
cases.expected_observation: Both existing behaviors are preserved via a tracked generated module, not falsely counted as missing registry actions.

cases.title: Asset and path authorization
cases.scenario: Exercise allowed assets, missing file, ../ traversal, symlink escape, large binary/text asset and unrelated edits.
cases.expected_observation: Only allowed workspace resources load; binary/text remain distinct; caching is measured, not assumed.

cases.title: Header metadata roundtrip
cases.scenario: Roundtrip targets, input/output types, noInput, share/quick-action surfaces, name and nondefault icon; include unknown native metadata.
cases.expected_observation: Verified fields preserve exact semantics; unknown fields survive; no fabricated widget/watch or minimum-version defaults.

cases.title: Setup indices and askEachTime
cases.scenario: Bind setup to action zero and after function/lowering expansion; misuse/reuse it and insert an unfilled editor placeholder.
cases.expected_observation: Stable node/parameter binding yields final correct indices; illegal use fails; holes do not become silent prompts.

cases.title: Existing triggers and declarations
cases.scenario: Migrate seven existing trigger families and declare a custom static action with registered codec; inject invalid bindings.
cases.expected_observation: Payloads preserve current verified behavior; no automation-install claim; invalid declarations fail.

cases.title: Syntax-aware migration
cases.scenario: Migrate a program containing metadata/setup/ref directives, old interpolation, indices, includes, has-value comparisons and functions.
cases.expected_observation: Meaning is preserved through structural transformation; no global directive deletion/regex-only rewrite.

cases.title: Atomic failed migration
cases.scenario: Force an unrepresentable conversion and a destination write failure while --write is requested.
cases.expected_observation: Original file remains unchanged; diagnostic/native fallback or explicit failure; no partial overwrite.

cases.title: Native forms and unknown values
cases.scenario: Roundtrip raw literals/UUID-like text/binary/date/unknown enum, static variants, omission and ordered aggrandizements.
cases.expected_observation: Typed/native codecs preserve exact semantic tree and reference topology; no normalization erases unknown information.

cases.title: Shared intake formats
cases.scenario: Import XML, binary plist, unsigned Shortcut and JSON workflow; provide AEA1 signed bytes.
cases.expected_observation: Supported formats use same preservation pipeline; unsupported signed extraction fails accurately without pretending to decode.

cases.title: Allowed edit and fail-closed gate
cases.scenario: Apply one authorized field change, then inject unrelated metadata loss/reference damage; remove the comparator tool.
cases.expected_observation: Only authorized delta passes; missing comparator or mismatch blocks finalization/signing and preserves the workspace.

cases.title: Contextual service and LSP
cases.scenario: Send partial named calls, enums, scoped identifiers, multiple errors and real LSP requests with UTF-16/negotiated positions.
cases.expected_observation: Correct contextual labels/types/signatures/ranges; genuine framing and method behavior, not capability strings only.

cases.title: Format, rename and stale edits
cases.scenario: Format twice; rename shadowed Unicode symbols; preserve same words in strings/comments; deliver out-of-order analysis responses.
cases.expected_observation: Stable contents, semantic symbol-only edits, and stale-response rejection with correct caret spans.

cases.title: Actual Swift integration
cases.scenario: Build the real app, open v2 source, request completion/diagnostics/rename and compile through the app on iOS.
cases.expected_observation: Actual Swift call paths use modern service/protocol and shared registry; C export presence alone is insufficient.

cases.title: Preview bounded source edit
cases.scenario: Edit one mapped action parameter in rich preview; attempt a generated/unmapped action edit.
cases.expected_observation: Only correct source region changes; unrelated comments/code preserved; unmapped edits are explained/read-only.

cases.title: Real public CLI and installed tools
cases.scenario: Invoke actual help-documented compile/check/format/import/schema/alias commands and cherri-migrate from extracted install.
cases.expected_observation: Commands really exist, share the same pipeline, and have reliable JSON/exit/output behavior.

cases.title: Output/signing failure behavior
cases.scenario: Test output paths/spaces/non-ASCII/permissions, failed encoding/signer, explicit Linux remote-sign request and unsigned check.
cases.expected_observation: No swallowed errors or wrong destination; no unsolicited signing; no unsigned bytes claimed signed.

cases.title: Skill compatibility rejection
cases.scenario: Select outdated bundled and cached compilers, invalid capabilities JSON, incompatible protocol/schema and mismatched docs.
cases.expected_observation: Doctor/install fails or selects verified compatible replacement; no existence-only or language-string-only success.

cases.title: Exact install and rollback
cases.scenario: Install an exact source/digest, verify migration binary, run offline with compatible cache, corrupt replacement checksum and interrupt update.
cases.expected_observation: Resolved immutable revisions match; atomic activation; compatible previous installation survives update failures.

cases.title: Docs and Skill retrieval coherence
cases.scenario: Collect runnable/invalid/contextual examples in both repos and query action/docs wrappers from the packaged Skill.
cases.expected_observation: Active f-string/commands/enums match actual compiler; legacy docs are not silently selected; fingerprints and generated outputs agree.

cases.title: Native encoding negative gate
cases.scenario: Break one REQUIRED encoding EXPECT in an isolated verification input and then run the correct set.
cases.expected_observation: Broken expectation fails gate nonzero; expected rejection passes; normal run reports actual per-form outcomes.

cases.title: Real runtime computed assertions
cases.scenario: Compile/import/run all required safe new-language fixtures on actual Simulator Shortcuts with reset channels and per-case identities.
cases.expected_observation: Assertions depend on computed values/types/effects; no unconditional sentinel can counterfeit a pass.

cases.title: Final SHA and artifact binding
cases.scenario: Collect all required event types/attempts and artifact metadata for final source F; inject earlier-SHA and missing artifacts.
cases.expected_observation: Only completed successful required gates and compatible F artifacts satisfy closure; pending/skipped/stale evidence does not.

cases.title: Executable AI evaluation harness
cases.scenario: Run held-out generation/edit task harness against a fake adapter to test control flow; run actual models only with an authorized configured endpoint.
cases.expected_observation: Task suite and runner genuinely exist; fake run is not AI quality evidence; external absence yields AI_EVAL_NOT_RUN with instructions.

cases.title: Performance and race evidence
cases.scenario: Measure cold/warm small/medium/large/asset fixtures and concurrent service/alternating compile-error-success sessions.
cases.expected_observation: Real p50/p95, environment and cache metrics; stable state isolation and no fabricated sub-millisecond claim.

cases.title: No accidental second user frontend
cases.scenario: Inspect production entrypoints and compile actual old user source, while running isolated trusted old declaration/migration reference paths.
cases.expected_observation: Only approved new public language is accepted; preserved upstream inputs remain build/reference resources, not hidden user execution fallback.
